shared_elements: low-relief carving on a large upright stone block/pillar
curved/arched body of a quadruped-like creature across the upper part of the surface
justification: Both surfaces are upright monolithic slabs bearing shallow, highly schematic low-relief motifs, and each carries a single arching animal-like form in profile across the upper zone (the crouching/arched quadruped on B, and the small animal figures near the top of A). But A depicts an anthropomorphic monument — a head with facial features, arms and belted torso covered with discs, rosettes and bands — while B shows only an isolated arched beast with no figural or ornamental context, so the shared content amounts to little more than "a schematic animal in relief on a standing stone".
